meta.name: publish
meta.description: Publish oh-my-opencode to npm by triggering the GitHub Actions publish workflow and verifying its artifacts. Ship-only: never runs pre-publish-review or re-reviews merged code unless the user explicitly asks. Argument: <patch|minor|major>. Triggers: publish, release, deploy, npm publish.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目新版本发布到 npm 并验证发布产物
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要一键把代码包发布到 npm 并确认发布成功
copy.tagline_en: Publish a new version of your project to npm and verify the outputs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ship a code package to npm and confirm it succeeded

howto.what: 装上后，你说“发布”等词，Claude 会执行完整发布流程：确认版本类型（patch/minor/major）、同步代码、触发 GitHub Actions、验证发布、撰写发布说明、发 Discord 公告、核对 npm 包。它只负责发布，不做代码审查。
howto.when: 当你说出“publish”“release”“deploy”等触发词，或要求发布到 npm 时触发；同时必须指定版本类型（patch/minor/major）。

say.text: 请发布一个 patch 版本
帮我 release minor 版本
say.note: Claude 会确认并执行发布

say.text: deploy 一个 major 版本

howto.what_en: After installation, when you say "publish" etc., Claude will run the full release workflow: confirm the bump type (patch/minor/major), sync code, trigger GitHub Actions, verify the release, write release notes, post to Discord, and verify npm packages. It only ships; it never re-reviews code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "publish", "release", "deploy", or ask to publish to npm; you must also specify the bump type (patch/minor/major).

say_en.note: Claude confirms and executes the release
